description:
## [1.17.0](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.16.1...v1.17.0) (2026-11-15)

### Kick

#### ✨ New Features

* add **Player gestures**
* add **Refresh stream**
* add **Third-party badges** with 7TV badges

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Third-party emotes:** load the channel's emotes, not only global ones

### Rumble

#### ✨ New Features

* add **Anonymous chat**
* add **Show video stats**

### Twitch

#### ✨ New Features

* add **Block update prompts**
* add **Don't save searches**
* add Favorite emotes to the emote picker
* add **Show exact counts**
* hide offline channels and recent streams on the React Native Home
* highlight chosen users and roles in **Chat keywords**
* suggest emotes while typing, without ':' first

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* keep **third-party emotes** loaded instead of downloading them again
* open on Following in the **tablet layout** too
* Sleep timer now pauses streams played with **Force ExoPlayer**

### Shared

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* open Lurk settings in installs whose manifest lacks its activity
